parts.name: Switch (Upper Button)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper button of a wall switch, made of durable plastic, typically circular and slightly protruding from the base plate.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one of the main control buttons to open or close an electrical circuit, turning a device on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch (Lower Button)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower button of a wall switch, made of plastic, similar in shape and function to the upper button.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a secondary control button, often used for a separate circuit or light source.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its resting position through a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or faceplate of the wall switch, made of insulating plastic, rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switch buttons and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the mounting surface for the switch assembly.
